description: This file defines the CouldNotCreateChecksumException class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically under the Exception namespace. It implements a custom exception used when checksum calculation fails during an upload process.

classes.name: CouldNotCreateChecksumException
classes.description: Custom exception class indicating a failed checksum calculation during an AWS SDK upload process, extending the standard RuntimeException and implementing MonitoringEventsInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception message based on the checksum algorithm and optional previous exception, providing guidance for resolving checksum errors.
